name: Emissions; application of lime fertilizer; at field
description: Emissions to air resulting from the application of 1kg of lime fertilizer in the US. Emissions calculated according to IPCC Tier 1 methods for applied fertilizers in the US.
category: 11: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting/1151: Support Activities for Crop Production

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Use for applied fertilizers in the US.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Emissions calculated according to IPCC Tier 1 methods for applied fertilizers in the US.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: CO2 emissions to air resulting from the application of 1kg of lime fertilizer in the US. Emissions calculated according to IPCC Tier 1 methods for applied fertilizers in the US.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Data for emissions only, to be applied with the application of 1kg lime fertilizer in the US.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Emissions calculated according to IPCC Tier 1 methods for applied fertilizers in the US.

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.
processDocumentation.projectDescription: Data were prepared by the University of Arkansas Center for Agricultural and Rural Sustainability for the United States Department of Agriculture National Agriculture Library.
